rules.description: Applicant must have qualifying income: self-employed, company director, landlord, or untaxed income
rules.reason_if_failed: You only need to register for Self Assessment if you're self-employed, a company director, receive rental income, or have other untaxed income. Check if you need to send a tax return.

rules.description: Applicant must not have an active Self Assessment registration
rules.reason_if_failed: You already have an active Self Assessment registration. Use your existing Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) to file your return.

rules.description: Check if applicant has inactive registration requiring reactivation
rules.reason_if_failed: You have a previous Self Assessment registration that needs reactivating. Follow the reactivation process instead.

rules.description: Applicant must be a UK taxpayer or have UK tax obligations
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for UK taxpayers. If you're a non-UK resident with UK income, contact HMRC International.

rules.description: Registration must be completed by 5 October in tax year following income
rules.reason_if_failed: You are registering after the 5 October deadline. You may receive a penalty. Continue with registration but expect a late registration penalty notice.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a partner in a business partnership
edge_cases.action: Partnership income requires additional registration details. Route to partnership-specific registration flow.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has multiple income sources requiring Self Assessment
edge_cases.action: Multiple income sources require careful classification. Agent should gather all income details before proceeding.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is non-UK resident but has UK-source income
edge_cases.action: Non-residents with UK income may need Self Assessment but have different rules. Hand off to HMRC International team.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has recently ceased self-employment but needs final return
edge_cases.action: You may still need to register to file a final tax return for the year you ceased trading. Continue with registration.

edge_cases.description: Applicant earning over £50,000 with child benefit in household
edge_cases.action: High earners with child benefit in household must register and report via Self Assessment to pay the High Income Child Benefit Charge.
